title: NVRAM store reset on a bad store or Setup size mismatch

references.location: map table entries at file offset 880-A70

description: AMI's DXE map assigns 60=DxeCore start, 61=NVRAM init, b6=NVRAM cleanup and b7=configuration reset. NVRAMDxe resets the store on a bad _FVH or store check, or on a Setup/IntelSetup size mismatch (PR9 0x6C/0x17A4, MR9A 0x7D/0x17CB, matching each IFR). Every saved store passes the size gate. The corrected captures put the loop's b0/b7 inside MRC, before DXE IPL (4F), so this path does not own the loop.
remediation: No change; the size gate is intended AMI behavior.
